note_on_scope: This is a PROTOCOL ruling, not a provenance addendum. It deliberately does NOT use the addendum schema and is never read by decodeProvenanceAddendum. It waives no gate and edits no instrument.

prior_evidence.immutability: PRESERVED EXACTLY AS OBSERVED. Not rewritten, not re-run to agree, not reinterpreted.

finding.circularity: The prior protocol ordering was 28/28 -> RESUME -> introduce AW_ADMIN_TEST_B. Three of the 28 gates require facts belonging to the live authenticated reviewer-B session, so 28/28 was unreachable while AW_ADMIN_TEST_B stayed unused.
finding.source_basis: admin_get_death_verification_case projects release.reviewer_a and release.authorized. It has NO projection of an acting release admin; that fact does not exist until reviewer B acts. Verified in db/functions/operator_console.sql.
finding.instrument_was_correct: REFUSE_RESUME was the correct output for absent facts. An unobserved fact is a FAILED gate, never a skipped one.
finding.vacuous_pass_noted: reviewer_identities_not_swapped passed in the pre-B run only because its predicate is a negation over an absent acting identity. It is NOT evidence in that state and must be re-evaluated with the real reviewer-B identity present.

ruling: The pre-B Session-2 preflight result of 25/28 PASS / REFUSE_RESUME is preserved exactly as observed and is NOT equivalent to RESUME.
All production, provenance and release-readiness gates available before reviewer-B authentication were green.
The only refusing gates were observed_reviewers_distinct, acting_admin_is_reviewer_b and acting_admin_has_aal2.
Those three predicates require facts belonging to the live authenticated reviewer-B Session-2 operator and therefore cannot become evaluable or passing while AW_ADMIN_TEST_B remains unused.
This ruling authorizes introducing AW_ADMIN_TEST_B solely for establishing the reviewer-B Session-2 authenticated context required to evaluate those three gates and rerun the canonical preflight.
This ruling does NOT authorize release.
This ruling does NOT authorize invocation of the irreversible release writer.
The release boundary remains 28/28 PASS plus canonical verdict RESUME from a fresh authenticated reviewer-B Session-2 preflight.
authorized_actions: authenticate AW_ADMIN_TEST_B via the canonical password + TOTP step-up path
read the authenticated session's own uid and assurance level from the canonical session source
collect a fresh Session-2 observation from the reviewer-B context
rerun the pinned canonical Session-2 preflight unmodified
prohibited_actions: invoke authorize_release or any irreversible release writer
modify database identity records to satisfy a gate
simulate or hand-populate an AAL claim
substitute a service-role session for reviewer-B authentication
authenticate AW_ADMIN_TEST_A as reviewer B, or swap the identities
modify the preflight instrument, suppress a gate, or weaken an assertion

identity_constraints.AW_ADMIN_TEST_B: reviewer B / Session-2 acting release admin only
identity_constraints.distinctness: must be established from actual canonical UIDs, never inferred from the labels A and B

authorized_state_transition: COLLECT FRESH LIVE SESSION-2 OPERATOR OBSERVATION
terminal_boundary: STOP at RESUME. The irreversible release requires separate explicit authorization and is out of scope for this ruling.
